extracted.intended_audience: SABEW members and business journalists (including book authors); Canadian SABEW members for the Canadian contest; applicants for Goldschmidt Fellowships
extracted.subtask_description: Information and entry guidance for SABEW's suite of awards and fellowships, including eligibility notes (membership, nationality), timing, and the kinds of work or service each award recognizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best in Business Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: SABEW celebrates the best in business journalism in an annual contest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It’s highly competitive and open to members in good standing at the date of entering. It typically runs December through early February.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best in Business Book Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: The Best in Business Book Awards recognize and celebrate outstanding business books as a standalone category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award is now open for submissions and focuses specifically on business books, distinct from the general Best in Business annual awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canadian Best in Business Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: A unique contest for Canadian individual and institutional members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Canadian members can enter this contest just after the all-member contest closes in early February.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguished Achievement Award
rubrics_metrics.description: An award established in 1993 that singles out individuals who have made a significant impact on the field of business journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also recognizes those who have served as a nurturing influence on others in the profession.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goldschmidt Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: An annual fellowship program providing a government data immersion experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program funds up to 20 Fellows; it is funded by the Walter and Karla Goldschmidt Foundation. 2026 marks the 12th year of the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: President's Award
rubrics_metrics.description: An award given at the discretion of the current SABEW president.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is made by the sitting president and is discretionary (no additional criteria provided on this page).
